name: Microsoft Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)

third_party_evaluations.summary: Entry-level Microsoft security/compliance/identity literacy across Azure, Entra, Purview, Defender.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Security, compliance and identity fundamentals provide a useful entry security-track baseline; the recorded literacy scope, zero experience and limited hiring signal prevent an associate operational inference.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded security, compliance and identity basics across Microsoft services provide a foundational technical vocabulary. NICCS listing and modern product coverage do not overcome zero experience and the limited entry hiring signal.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded security, compliance and identity coverage provides a focused entry security baseline across Microsoft services. Zero experience and the limited hiring signal keep it foundational rather than an operational credential.
